jobs.title: Senior Web Program Manager
jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

1. About Our Client:

The organization operates in the Connected Operations cloud platform industry, providing Internet of Things (IoT) data solutions to organizations reliant on physical operations. These operations span critical sectors such as agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing, which represent more than 40% of the global GDP. The organization addresses challenges in these industries by enabling actionable insights that improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability on a global scale.

2. About the Opportunity:

The Senior Web Program Manager
is responsible for overseeing multiple interconnected digital projects and driving complex web initiatives that align with the organization's objectives. This role brings structure, streamlined processes, and best practices to the digital program, ensuring the delivery of high-impact programs through strategic planning, stakeholder management, and team coordination.

3. Responsibilities:

Manage all phases of complex, cross-functional digital programs from ticket management to delivery
Develop comprehensive program plans including business requirements, technical specifications, schedules, funding, and resource allocation
Track milestones and deliverables, provide status updates to stakeholders and senior executives, and manage risks and dependencies
Lead process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and quality
Act as a strategic liaison translating business objectives into actionable roadmaps
Communicate with executives to align priorities and present program progress
Facilitate team discussions, resolve conflicts, and remove obstacles
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Creative, IT, PMM, Campaigns, and development for digital initiatives
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to define website functionality and oversee product development to deployment
Manage relationships with external agencies, consultants, and contractors
Document development processes and establish best practices
Implement mitigation strategies to reduce project risks and drive continuous improvement

4. Requirements:

7+ years of project management experience in a digital agency or internal digital department focusing on digital projects
Proficiency with project management tools such as Airtable, Jira, Google Sheets, and software like Google Suite, Salesforce, and Tableau
Experience integrating AI tools to enhance program management efficiency
Strong understanding of digital production processes, timelines, and scoping
Experience launching digital solutions with ongoing analysis and product improvements
Knowledge of software development processes and Agile methodologies including Scrum and Kanban
Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
Ability to work effectively with external agencies, consultants, and contractors
Proactive in identifying and resolving obstacles and risks collaboratively

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:

The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

The Program Manager drives complex technical programs from planning through delivery, coordinating engineering, product, infrastructure, security, and customer-facing teams across the software development lifecycle.

This role creates the operating rhythm for high-priority initiatives: translating strategy into milestones, managing dependencies and risks, and giving leadership a clear view of progress across cloud platforms, APIs, data systems, and internal tooling.

Key Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional programs from scope definition through launch, establishing milestones, owners, success metrics, and delivery plans
Coordinate engineering and product teams across Jira, Linear, Confluence, Slack, and related planning tools to maintain accurate execution visibility
Manage dependencies across software, cloud infrastructure, security, data, and customer operations teams; escalate blockers with clear options and recommendations
Run program reviews, standups, planning sessions, and executive updates that surface status, risks, decisions, and resource needs
Build and maintain program documentation, including roadmaps, RAID logs, project plans, release criteria, and post-launch retrospectives
Track delivery metrics such as milestone attainment, cycle time, incident impact, and scope change; use data to improve planning and execution
Drive process improvements across Agile and hybrid delivery environments, standardizing templates, governance, and communication practices

What We Are Looking For

3-8 years of experience in technical program management, project management, product operations, or software delivery
Experience managing complex, cross-functional initiatives involving engineering, product, infrastructure, security, or data teams
Working knowledge of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, cloud platforms, APIs, CI/CD, and production release processes
Hands-on experience with project and documentation tools such as Jira or Linear, Confluence or Notion, and Slack; strong proficiency with spreadsheets and reporting
Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, resolve dependencies, communicate risks, and deliver programs on schedule
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, business, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Bonus: Experience with Kubernetes, AWS or GCP, data platforms, security compliance programs, developer tooling, or scaled Agile transformation

jobs.title: EHV EPC Project Manager (Power Delivery)- Remote
jobs.description:
Job Description

WSP is seeking EHV EPC Project Manager (Power Delivery)- Remote
for our Power & Energy Program Management Office in Portland, OR.
The following locations will also be considered: Los Angeles, CA, San Francisco, CA, San Diego, CA, Seattle, WA, Boise, ID, Helena, MT and Phoenix, AZ.
In this position, you will be responsible for cradle-to-grave execution of high-voltage transmission EPC projects, from project development and design through construction, energization, and final closeout.

This Opportunity

This position provides high level technical project leadership, and guidance with managing the administrative, commercial, and technical components of EHV Transmission and Substation project(s) or portfolio of projects in accordance with WSP’s core values, and the level of project services agreed upon in the contract by WSP and the client(s).

Responsible for the overall performance of assigned project(s) that are moderate and larger size/complexity and regional in scope, and includes oversight for financial, technical, client satisfaction, quality, safety, and schedule.

Ensures that responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, project startup and planning, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable corporate standards for safety, execution, profitability, and operational purpose.

Your Impact

Coordinate and communicate with all levels of management and disciplines throughout the project life cycle to support project cost and schedule objectives, both internally and within the client’s systems.
Lead the development of project proposals, cost estimates, scope, schedules, and resource plans
Oversee management of budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, cost and change management and control.
Provide regular project reporting and updates to clients, technical leads, and business leaders, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget and mitigation strategies.
Be the face of WSP for the client. Develop and nurture strong, long-term relationships with client by understanding their needs, providing tailored solutions, and ensuring consistent communication to drive satisfaction and retention.
Adherence to proven processes and ability to develop new processes to standardize procedures.
Adhere to safety regulations and enforce project safety standards
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (Electrical, Civil, Mechanical, Project Management or Construction Management), Engineering Technology, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience within an A/E/C firm, utility, EPC, or power delivery consulting environment.
10+ years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within our industry.
3+ years of EHV transmission level voltage project experience (115kV up to 500kV)
Cradle to grave EPC project management experience for transmission level voltage
Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process and strong background and experience in project management. Experience managing projects through a variety of delivery models (DBB, EPC, PDB).
Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet project-specific needs.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:

Expected Salary (all locations): $120,000 - $210,000

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

jobs.title: Sr IT Project Manager - Site Builds
jobs.description:
A Day in Your Life at MKS:

As an Infrastructure Sr Project Manager – IT Site Builds at MKS, you will work cross-functionally with Infrastructure & Operations, Facilities, Construction, Security, End User Services, Procurement, OCIO, Partner and Vendor Management (PVM), IT Financial Management (ITFM), business stakeholders, and external vendors to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of IT deliverables for new site builds, site expansions, relocations, and site modification projects. In this role, you will report to the Director of IT Programs.

You Will Make an Impact By:

Lead and manage IT project delivery activities for new site builds, site modifications, office expansions, relocations, and retrofit projects, ensuring alignment with construction timelines, business readiness, and go-live milestones.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, resource plans, dependency trackers, and readiness checkpoints across required IT workstreams, including network, MDF/IDF, server room, wireless, UCaaS, structured cabling, telecom, collaboration, and end-user compute requirements.
Serve as the primary IT project lead for assigned site build initiatives, coordinating cross-functional delivery with Infrastructure, Security, End User Services, Facilities, Construction, Procurement, PMO, business teams, and external vendors.
Facilitate project meetings, readiness reviews, issue resolution sessions, leadership updates, and stakeholder communications to ensure milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
Support project budget development, forecasting, purchase order coordination, vendor quotes, statements of work, material readiness, delivery schedules, installation activities, and tracking of scope, schedule, and cost performance.
Maintain active management of project risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, and changes; proactively identify construction delays, supply chain constraints, technical dependencies, and resource conflicts; and drive mitigation plans through resolution.
Ensure site deployments adhere to enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, operational support expectations, project governance practices, stage gates, cutover planning, turnover documentation, and service transition requirements.
Coordinate operational readiness and go-live transition activities, including hypercare planning, support handoff, asset and documentation updates, escalation procedures, post-project reviews, and lessons learned.
Travel Requirements: Up to 20% of travel may be required based on project and site needs.

Skills You Bring:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
5+ years of project management experience in IT infrastructure, site deployment, workplace technology, or related technology programs.
Exceptional problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work through complex, cross-functional processes, identify inefficiencies, and drive improvements while maintaining project execution.
Comfortable speaking up, influencing stakeholders at all levels, and constructively challenging established practices when necessary.
Experience managing projects involving network and wireless deployments, datacenter/server room or MDF/IDF readiness, UCaaS/voice/collaboration technologies, structured cabling, telecom coordination, or end-user technology deployment initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with complex schedules, dependencies, vendor coordination, and stakeholder groups.
Strong knowledge of project management practices including scheduling, budgeting, risk management, issue management, change control, governance, and stakeholder communication.
Experience coordinating internal technical teams and third-party vendors in deadline-driven environments.
Proficiency with project management and reporting tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, ServiceNow, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, or similar platforms.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively to technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership.

Preferred Skills:

Experience supporting manufacturing, warehouse, laboratory, office, or multi-use facility environments.
Experience with global or multi-site IT deployment programs and geographically distributed project teams.
Familiarity with MDF/IDF design considerations, structured cabling standards, rack and stack planning, telecom room readiness, and physical infrastructure dependencies.
Working knowledge of enterprise networking, security dependencies, infrastructure support models, IT service transition, and operational handoff processes.
Experience in organizations with established PMO governance, project stage gates, scope and change control, and formal risk and issue management practices.
Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, CAPM, ITIL Foundation, Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery experience is beneficial.

Supervisory Scope:

Reporting Relationships: Reports to the Director, Technology Programs / Site Modernization Program Lead. This role does not have direct people management responsibilities but will lead cross-functional project teams and vendor delivery activities.
Financial Responsibilities: Supports development and tracking of project budgets, forecasts, purchase orders, vendor quotes, project expenditures, and cost/schedule variances for assigned site build initiatives.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

Ability to work in both office and project site environments as needed.
May require walking active construction or build sites, attending site readiness meetings, and coordinating with site vendors and contractors.
Occasional lifting of small technology equipment or participation in physical site readiness validation may be required.
Ability to travel to domestic and/or international locations based on project demands.

In addition to the above responsibilities, the following are considered material job duties of the position:

Ability to take and follow directions and instructions.
Ability to interact with other employees, customers, suppliers, vendors, or the public, in a safe, professional, and respectful manner.
Access to sensitive and confidential business systems and software, personally identifying information, the company’s financial information, and/or the ability to maintain physical security and safety.
Because this position involves the above material job duties, trustworthiness, reliability, and good judgment also are material job duties.

This position is Remote
. Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

Compensation and Benefits:

Salary Pay Range:
$88,000 - $147,000 per year. This range is a good faith estimate of the expected salary range for this position, based on a wide range of factors including qualifications, experience and training, operational and business needs and other considerations permitted by law. At MKS, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for the role.

Bonus:
This position is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, in an amount to be determined by MKS [or as applicable].

Benefits:
MKS offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance coverage (medical, dental and vision), 401(k) with company match, life and disability insurance, 12 paid holidays, sick time, 15 paid vacation days, [6 weeks fully paid] parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition reimbursement [and for participation in any stock programs, signing bonus, etc.].

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position.

MKS is an equal opportunity employer, including disability, veteran status and all categories protected by law. Please review our EOE statements for additional details. MKS is generally only hiring candidates who reside in states where we are registered to do business.

MKS will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act and the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers.

Project Manager, FSA - Homebased - Mexico or Brazil

ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

As a Project Manager, Feasibility and Site Activation (FSA) at ICON, you will be responsible for planning and manage Feasibility and Site Activation (FSA) activities for assigned clinical studies.

What You Will Do

You will oversee site start-up and activation workstreams, ensuring deliverables meet quality and timeline expectations.

Developing and managing FSA project plans, timelines, and deliverables for assigned studies.
Coordinating feasibility assessments, country and site recommendations, and start-up strategies in collaboration with functional experts.
Overseeing essential document collection, ethics and regulatory submissions, and site activation milestones.
Tracking progress against timelines and KPIs, proactively identifying risks and implementing mitigation plans.
Serving as the primary FSA contact for internal teams and customers for study-level start-up matters.
Contributing to process improvement and best practice sharing within the FSA project management team.

Your Profile

You will have solid site start-up and activation experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, healthcare, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Strong experience in clinical research with a focus on feasibility, site activation, or start-up project management.
Proven ability to manage project plans, timelines, and cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced environment.
Good understanding of regulatory, ethics, and contractual requirements affecting study start-up.
Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
Detail-oriented and proactive, with a commitment to quality, predictability, and customer satisfaction.
Willingness to travel as required (approximately 10%)

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) powers the global infrastructure behind Microsoft's cloud platforms. Within CO+I, EPC is responsible for delivering hyperscale datacenter programs that enable continued growth of Microsoft's cloud services worldwide.

Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you will validate sequencing and durations, drive schedule governance, and improve predictability through scenario modelling, schedule analytics, and acceleration planning.

The Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) team delivers complex, multi-year infrastructure programmes across multiple regions, bringing together expertise in engineering, construction, sourcing, project controls, and delivery. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Partner with Central Project Controls Estimating, Cost, Risk, regional planning leadership, and cross-functional teams to align global strategy with regional execution needs.
Schedule & Planning Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert in Primavera P6 EPPM and integrated master schedule best practices. Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field AND experience in program management, project controls, planning, scheduling, OR equivalent experience.

Experience managing hyperscale Data Centre programs across multiple regions, business units, or large portfolios.

Strong communication and technical writing skills with experience presenting to senior leadership / Director level
Experience developing and implementing processes, procedures, and governance frameworks
Experience delivering training and onboarding programs for technical teams

As a Technical Program Manager, Space Systems, you will lead execution of one of our most advanced space programs from system design through Initial Operating Capability (IOC). You will be responsible for driving the successful delivery of the Vantage satellite system by integrating engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, launch preparation, mission operations, and customer stakeholders into a single executable program.

This role owns technical program execution—not engineering design authority. You will partner closely with engineering leaders to ensure technical decisions, schedules, risks, suppliers, and operational activities remain aligned to mission objectives. Success requires balancing technical understanding with exceptional execution, anticipating issues before they become program risks, and driving cross-functional teams toward critical milestones.

You will coordinate internal engineering organizations and external partners responsible for spacecraft development, payload integration, launch preparation, ground segment integration, mission operations, and system commissioning. From preliminary design through launch, LEOP, on-orbit commissioning, and operational readiness, you will ensure every element of the mission comes together as a cohesive operational capability.

We are looking for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, communicates clearly across technical disciplines, makes informed decisions quickly, removes execution barriers, and maintains relentless focus on delivering mission success.

Minimum Qualifications

Must be a U.S. Citizen
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
10+ years of technical program management, systems engineering, or engineering leadership experience delivering complex aerospace or high-reliability hardware systems.
Demonstrated experience managing development and execution of spacecraft, satellites, launch vehicle systems, or similarly complex multidisciplinary engineering programs.
Experience leading cross-functional technical programs spanning multiple engineering organizations and external suppliers.
Strong understanding of spacecraft development lifecycles from design through integration, environmental test, launch, commissioning, and operations.
Experience coordinating hardware, software, systems engineering, manufacturing, integration and test, mission operations, and customer stakeholders.
Experience managing external contractors, subsystem vendors, and strategic suppliers.
Demonstrated ability to identify technical, schedule, and programmatic risks early and drive effective mitigation plans.
Experience managing complex technical schedules, dependencies, critical paths, and program milestones.
Familiarity with spacecraft integration and test campaigns, launch site activities, and mission readiness reviews.
Understanding of ground segment integration, space-to-ground interfaces, mission planning, and operational readiness activities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across engineering teams, executives, customers, and external partners.
Demonstrated ownership mentality with a history of driving programs to successful completion in fast-paced, execution-focused environments.
Ability to travel as required to customer locations, suppliers, integration facilities, launch sites, and operational centers.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering complete space missions from concept through Initial Operating Capability.
Experience managing development of remote sensing, Earth observation, ISR, or other exquisite spacecraft and payload systems.
Experience coordinating spacecraft bus development, payload integration, and system-level verification across multiple organizations.
Experience integrating commercial and government-furnished equipment (CFE/GFE) into operational space systems.
Experience leading development and verification of space-to-ground interfaces across spacecraft, communications infrastructure, mission operations, and ground software.
Experience planning and executing Launch and Early Orbit Operations (LEOP) and on-orbit commissioning campaigns.
Experience preparing organizations for operational readiness, mission rehearsals, and sustained on-orbit operations.
Familiarity with launch vehicle integration activities and launch campaign execution.
Working knowledge of systems engineering practices including interface management, technical baselines, configuration management, verification planning, and risk management.
Experience supporting U.S. Government space programs or National Security Space missions.
Active U.S. Secret security clearance or ability to obtain and maintain one.

This position requires a technical leader who can connect engineering execution across every phase of the mission. You will establish program priorities, maintain alignment across internal teams and external partners, resolve issues before they impact delivery, and ensure technical, operational, and business objectives remain synchronized.

Our most successful Technical Program Managers combine deep technical curiosity with disciplined execution. They build trust across organizations, communicate with clarity, make data-driven decisions, take ownership of difficult problems, and enable engineering teams to move quickly while maintaining the rigor required to deliver mission-critical space systems.

jobs.description:

1 October 2026

Department:
Research

Location:
Washington D.C.

$68,000 - $78,000 / year

Description

TL;DR
Kharon is seeking a full-time, in-office Research Analyst, Data Operations with working proficiency in a Mandarin (simplified and/or traditional), to join our team in Washington D.C. This role requires in office attendance.

Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a Director of Growth Marketing to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Data Operations, the core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics. This includes monitoring new sanctions, enforcement actions, and policy activity by regulatory agencies, as well as conducting research on international affairs that affect business risks. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies, perform detailed quality assurance, validate and reconcile data, and support new product and partnership initiatives. You’ll also play a key role in curating, publishing, and maintaining datasets, and may write original code to collect primary data across various languages. Cross-functional collaboration is essential as you help build out new research, surface insights from existing content, and report key project metrics to internal stakeholders.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

Responsibilities

Monitoring new sanctions, enforcement actions, and policy activity by regulatory agencies for developments relevant to Kharon’s products
Conducting research on issues in international affairs that impact business risks and identifying relevant data sources
Driving the curation, publication, maintenance, and quality assurance of datasets
Performing data validation and reconciliation to support new products and partnership initiatives
Accurately perform detailed quality assurance of data and developing additional tooling to support these tasks as necessary
Write original code needed to collect primary data in any number of different languages.
Collaborating cross-functionally to build out new research and develop insights based on Kharon’s existing content
Reporting key metrics on projects and share regular updates with stakeholders.

Qualifications

Must have a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Administration, International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, Regional Studies, History, Sociology, or a related field
Experience with sanctions, export controls, anti-money laundering or countering the financing of terrorism
Experience researching issues of international security and economy in high-risk jurisdictions
Understanding of securities markets, financial instruments, and investment risk
Must have working reading proficiency in Mandarin.
2+ years experience in coding languages (Python strongly preferred)
1+ year experience in using scraping and data parsing packages (e.g., Selenium, Scrapy, proxies, Captcha BeautifulSoup, pandas, etc.)
Experience with or willingness to learn SQL
Experience with data analysis, data visualization, and graph databases (Neo4J)
Understanding of or willingness to learn web technologies (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, XPath, JSON, etc).

Benefits

To keep that momentum going, we do our very best to make sure that each and every team member is completely taken care of. We’re nothing without our people and we strive to offer a package that reflects that. As a Kharon team member, you can expect:

Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurances
FSA program for both medical and dependent care
401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting
Flexible paid time off + 11 paid holidays

The base salary range at Kharon is set between $68,000-$78,000. Please note that this figure does not necessarily include potential bonuses, commissions, benefits, or equity that may be part of the overall compensation package.

If interested in pursuing this position, please visit www.kharon.com/careers to apply.

Kharon is an equal opportunity employer. Kharon is committed to cultivating and maintaining a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or identity, neurodiversity, appearances, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

The Data Analyst, Revenue Operations is responsible for turning data from multiple source systems into the reporting, models, and visualizations that power revenue, sales, and operations decision-making. Reporting into the Revenue Operations organization, this role combines hands-on SQL and data modeling with predictive segmentation, opportunity analysis, and dashboard development — and serves as a trusted reporting partner to teams across the business. You will work primarily within Revenue Operations while collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Business and Technical Operations, Sales Enablement, Support, and Finance to get things done.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

Be a Good Person, It's Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
Raise the Bar. Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

The Ideal Candidate

You Bring Strong Analytical Thinking, Intellectual Curiosity, And a Commitment To Accuracy. You Enjoy Connecting Information Across Disparate Systems, Identifying Meaningful Patterns, And Delivering Insights That Influence Business Decisions. The Opportunity To Build And Own These Capabilities During Your First Year Is Something You Find Energizing

Build and maintain the core revenue and customer-lifecycle reporting that gives sales and revenue leadership clear visibility into performance, trends, and health of the business
Develop and operationalize segmentation and predictive models in BigQuery ML that shape go-to-market targeting and account prioritization
Lead the migration of dashboards from legacy datasets and BI tools into Tableau, with documented data lineage and custom measures
Establish data quality and reconciliation practices that resolve entities across source systems and distinguish net-new from existing customers
Partner with teams across the organization to translate ambiguous, evolving requests into concrete reporting deliverables

Deliver ad-hoc and recurring analyses supporting Sales, Business and Technical Operations (Salesforce Admins), Revenue, Sales Enablement, Support, and other internal teams, with minimal supervision

Author complex SQL in BigQuery using multi-CTE pipelines, window functions, user-defined functions, and array aggregation, and build reusable views for data aggregation and downstream consumption
Build and refine segmentation and clustering models in BigQuery ML, including feature engineering, look-alike discovery, and cluster profiling, and operationalize model output into actionable deliverables for go-to-market teams
Size addressable-market and ideal-customer opportunities by identifying accounts whose profile fits specific products, and quantify whitespace and upsell potential to support Sales Enablement and account prioritization
Perform entity resolution across multiple source systems using fuzzy matching, normalization, and confidence scoring, reconciling records across platforms
Develop and maintain Tableau dashboards for key business metrics, and lead migration from legacy datasets and BI tools with documented data lineage, custom measures, and visual mappings
Maintain current knowledge of data sources and ongoing data warehouse developments, adapting models and reporting as schemas and requirements change
Translate ambiguous and evolving requests from a wide range of stakeholders into concrete reporting specifications
Contribute to a culture of data discipline, continuous improvement, and analytical excellence across the Revenue Operations organization

Skills & Experience

Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards in Tableau or comparable data visualization tools
Experience with data modeling and designing reusable views for aggregation and consumption

Strong analytical skills with the ability to surface trends, identify gaps, and translate data into clear recommendations
Experience working with CRM data (Salesforce preferred) and revenue/go-to-market datasets

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to partner effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders

jobs.description:
Bristol or London

About Us

Hoare Lea is a human-centric and planet-conscious engineering consultancy. We offer intelligent and sustainable solutions to complex design challenges for the built environment throughout the UK and further afield.

We provide a wide range of engineering and consultancy services, including acoustics, air quality, building services (MEP), fire, lighting, security and sustainability to name but a few. Together, our highly skilled teams use technical expertise and problem-solving skills to bring buildings to life. We ensure that whatever the building, its design is outstanding, and its operations meet the needs of the communities it serves.

We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

About The Role

Our multi-disciplinary software, product, and data team serves as a central hub of digital expertise and innovation, supporting projects across the company. We work collaboratively with engineers, consultants and other specialists to use data and technology to solve real-world problems and improve the services we provide to our clients.

We have an opportunity for a Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist to play a key role in using data, analytics, statistical methods and data science to generate insight, support decision-making and improve our engineering services.

This is a broad analytical role. You will work across the full lifecycle of a problem: understanding stakeholder needs, exploring and assessing data, identifying appropriate analytical approaches, communicating findings and, where appropriate, developing statistical or machine-learning models or client-ready insights/tools. This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and has a critical eye for finding the right solution for the problem. Sometimes this may be exploratory analysis, a dashboard or a set of clearly defined metrics; in other cases, it may involve forecasting, statistical modelling, machine learning or building/working with AI.

It's an exciting time to join our Digital team. Working alongside a range of specialist engineers and consultants, you will be joining a collaborative, knowledgeable, highly engaged team, and offer a supportive, flexible, and high-performing work culture. In a time where building and energy resilience is ever more important, we are driving forward innovation to make an impact with data and technology.

You will have the opportunity to engage in a variety of high-impact projects, working on challenging problems for some of the UK’s most notable organisations, including the NHS and Oxford University. Our team has recently worked on creating data science-led for managing estates in hospitals, building energy forecasting models, and harnessing data on building performance to create better designed buildings of the future.

In this key and varied role, you can expect to:

Work with engineers, consultants, product teams and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate sometimes ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical problems.
Develop and implement data-driven solutions to solve real-world business problems across the company.
Use SQL, Python and other analytical tools to investigate datasets, identify trends and relationships, test hypotheses and generate actionable insights.
Apply appropriate statistical techniques, forecasting methods, ML and AI approaches where they add value to the problem being solved.
Collaborate with the product and software engineering teams to turn analytical work into reusable tools, workflows and data-driven products where appropriate.
Develop reproducible and maintainable analytical code, following best practices, including version control, testing, and peer reviews.
Contribute to the development of analytical and data science capability across the business by sharing approaches, reusable methods and good practice

About You

To be successful in this role you’ll need:

Essential Skills

Experience applying data and analysis to real-world business, engineering or operational problems.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an initially ambiguous question and determine an appropriate analytical approach.
Ability to work on projects independently and own deliverables.
Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, visualisation and data science (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
Proficiency in data querying languages (e.g., SQL). Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (version control, unit testing, code review, etc.).
Strong experience with data visualisation frameworks (e.g., PowerBI, Streamlit).
Experience applying machine learning and AI, including generative AI, to real-world problems where it provides clear benefit.
Familiarity with statistical concepts and their application in data analysis.
Solid communication skills, capable of effectively engaging with and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI and other relevant standards.

Desirable Skills

Knowledge of the engineering industry and its challenges.
Experience with one of the major machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Knowledge of mathematical optimisation methods, such as linear, integer or constraint optimisation, and associated tools (e.g. OR-Tools).
Experience with MS Fabric or equivalent data warehousing solution.
Experience working in a cloud computing environment.
Familiarity with containerisation and deployment technologies (e.g., Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

For candidates joining at Senior
level, we would additionally expect you to lead more complex or ambiguous analytical projects, shape analytical approaches and overarching priorities, work independently with senior stakeholders, review and support the work of others, and help raise analytical standards across the team.

How To Apply

To apply simply complete a CV profile and submit your application.

If shortlisted, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to arrange an introductory call (about 30 minutes) to discuss the role and your experience in more detail. From there, successful candidates will be invited to attend a panel interview, either via Microsoft Teams or in person at one of our offices. We aim to provide feedback at each stage of the process.

Adjustments and accommodations

If there are adjustments or accommodations that we can put in place to help you participate and give your best at any stage of the recruitment process (whether relating to disability, neurodivergence or anything else) please let us know.

Data privacy

We have updated our terms and conditions for candidates, click here to find out more.

Recruitment agencies

We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners who assist us when required. We do not acknowledge speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Capital Solutions Group

Goldman Sachs operates at the fulcrum of one of the most important structural trends in finance: the convergence of public and private markets. We combine the #1 global advisory franchise, a leading origination business, and an investing platform that deploys capital across liquid and alternative asset classes.

Our Capital Solutions Group is a comprehensive suite of our financing, origination, structuring, and risk management solutions. The depth and breadth of our relationships, enriched by the velocity of our deal flow, provide clients unique insights to maximize value and unlock opportunity.

Our integrated structure is built to provide comprehensive, tailored solutions that propel both our issuing and investing clients forward.

Corporate Credit Portfolio Group

The Corporate Credit Portfolio Group manages Goldman’s relationship lending portfolio, a risk book with 100+ bln of corporate debt, ranging from investment grade to distressed. We are Street-facing and execute trading / hedging strategies in loans, CDS, bonds, options, tranches, and post-bankruptcy positions. The New York team is responsible for managing all of the group’s risk in the Americas. We are a small team, so each person is expected to gain expertise across a broad range of credits, industries, and products.

The role focuses on managing the portfolio and is great for an experienced credit research analyst with a strong skillset in credit analysis / investment skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced, market-oriented environment. You will analyze corporate credit, price risk across capital structures, and guide portfolio risk management. Candidates should be interested in managing risk at the micro / single-name level and at the macro level across 1,000+ credits in every industry.

Responsibilities Include

Perform fundamental analysis on companies and sectors
Develop, monitor, and update portfolio screens for news and price changes on 1,000+ credits
Follow and develop a credit view on a subset of the ~100 most topical names
Assist in executing cash and derivative trades
Develop views on appropriate hedge strategy, candidates for sales, and target prices
Value and mark positions, many of which are illiquid, by reviewing comps, extrapolating across the capital structure, and building models based on financial statements

Basic Requirements

3-5 years of experience in credit research and/or investing (buy-side or sell-side), and/or a related field such as investment banking and equity research. While there is the opportunity to learn more about distressed credit analysis and loans, we expect applicants to have strong fundamental credit skills, including financial modelling, valuation, relative value, and recovery analysis
Facility with basic fixed income math, risk metrics, and credit products
Familiarity with loans is a plus
Progress toward CFA (any level) is a plus

Salary Range

The expected base salary for this New York, New York, United States-based position is $150000-$225000. In addition, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus if you are an active employee as of fiscal year-end.

Benefits

Goldman Sachs is committed to providing our people with valuable and competitive benefits and wellness offerings, as it is a core part of providing a strong overall employee experience. A summary of these offerings, which are generally available to active, non-temporary, full-time and part-time US employees who work at least 20 hours per week, can be found here .

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

As a senior analyst in a well-funded, growth Series C start-up, you will be defining our growth potential for years to come. You will be an integral part of Reserv’s data team, working with our customers to deliver high-fidelity data and insights.

For this role, we are seeking data analysts with strong Python, SQL, and Excel skills. You should be curious about how claims work and how our systems process them. You’ll also need the ability to interface with customers from both technical and non-technical backgrounds, and to work independently while collaborating closely with our engineering and operations teams. If you are ready to help shape the vision for Reserv’s technology, join us on the journey.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

What You Will Do

Work with our data stack: Python (Pandas to NLTK), Postgres/dbt, Looker, Excel, etc.
Lead client calls through technical analysis to provide recommendations and insights
Ship reporting code and improve our data modeling layer to solve for our customers' needs
Work on problems that don’t have a clearly defined answer, often helping define the “right” solution
Communicate ideas and specifications through detailed, precise writing
Influence the culture, values, and processes of a growing engineering team
Enjoy and have fun being creative and thinking outside of the box. You will need to draw on analogous situations you’ve worked on before, but we are not traversing well-traveled roads. “Where we’re going, we don’t need roads!”

Qualifications

6-8 years of experience as an individual contributor with experience using modern analytics and programming languages—we’re in Python and dbt/Postgres every day
A proven ability to interface with high-value customers and communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences alike
Have a strong demonstrated toolkit to build ETLs and net new data visualizations/reports
Have a proven track record of shipping high quality data analysis at a high cadence
A passion for building intuitive technology and a thirst for learning
Able to think through customer requirements and prioritize what is a must-have, nice-to-have, or irrelevant
Have a strong technical skillset but also the willingness and ability to take over tasks outside your core competency

Benefits

Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Quality Verification and Standards (QVS)

Quality Verification and Standards(QVS) 팀은 개발 과정에서 중요한 역할을 담당하며, 게임팀이 소프트웨어 성능을 최적화하고 게임플레이를 향상시킬 수 있도록 실질적으로 활용 가능한 인사이트를 지속적으로 제공합니다. 이러한 노력을 통해 전 세계 플레이어와 팬들에게 몰입감과 영감을 주는 혁신적인 엔터테인먼트 경험을 제공할 수 있도록 지원합니다.

General Info

EA Korea에서 소프트웨어 개발 및 품질 향상과 관련된 프로젝트의 기획과 실행을 주도할 Software/Technical Project Manager를 모십니다. 이 역할에서는 소프트웨어 개발 전반에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 프로젝트를 End-to-End로 주도하고, 개발팀과 협업하여 품질 프로세스와 기술적 과제를 개선해 나가게 됩니다. Software/Technical Project Management 경험이 중요하며, 소프트웨어 품질 및 QA 프로세스에 대한 경험이나 지식이 있다면 역할을 수행하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

Responsibilities

End-to-End프로젝트 매니지먼트
프로젝트 목표와 실행 계획을 수립하고, 업무 범위, 일정, 리소스, 리스크 및 결과물을 관리하여 프로젝트가 성공적으로 수행될 수 있도록 이끕니다.
프로젝트의 성공적인 수행을 위해 R&R을 명확히 정의하고, 업무 범위와 일정에 따른 리소스를 계획하며(Scope-versus-Capacity Planning), 진행 상황과 주요 리스크를 투명하게 관리합니다.
품질, 생산성 및 운영 효율성을 측정할 수 있는 지표를 수립하고, 데이터와 결과를 바탕으로 구체적인 개선 성과를 만들어냅니다.

품질 프로세스 혁신 및 변화 주도 (Transformation)
게임 품질 향상을 위한 프로세스를 개선하고, 사내외 파트너와 효율적으로 협업할 수 있는 확장 가능한 운영 모델을 구축합니다.
개발팀 및 QE팀과 협업하여 AI/ML 솔루션, 테스트 자동화 및 새로운 기술을 게임 품질 프로세스에 도입하고, 실제 프로젝트에 적용될 수 있도록 확장 및 표준화합니다.

프로젝트 실행 전략 수립
게임 개발 스튜디오와 협업하여 게임 개발 및 라이브 서비스 과정에서 필요한 품질 향상 프로젝트와 실행 전략을 수립합니다.
프로젝트 목표, 측정 지표 및 성공 기준을 정의하고 품질, 생산성, 효율성 측면의 성과를 지속적으로 관리합니다.
결과 분석 및 개선 과제를 도출하여 주요 성과와 Best Practices를 관련 팀과 공유하고 확산합니다.

글로벌 및 외부 파트너(3rd Party) 협업 관리
외부 개발 및 QA 아웃소싱 파트너사의 효율적인 협업 프로세스를 정립하고 지속적으로 개선합니다.
외부 파트너사의 역량을 평가하고, 지속 가능하고 생산적인 협업 모델을 구축합니다.

소프트웨어/IT 산업에서 7년 이상의 경력을 보유하고, 소프트웨어 또는 기술 프로젝트를 End-to-End로 관리한 경험이 있으신 분.
프로젝트 목표 및 범위 설정, 일정·리소스·리스크 관리, 이해관계자 조율 등 프로젝트 전반을 주도적으로 관리할 수 있는 역량을 갖추신 분.
소프트웨어 개발 수명 주기(SDLC)에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 개발 조직과 협업한 경험이 있으며, Agile 등 소프트웨어 개발 방법론에 대한 이해가 있으신 분.

The Data Analyst turns product, customer, and operational data into reliable reporting and clear business decisions. The role works across SQL-based warehouses such as Snowflake or BigQuery, BI tools such as Looker or Tableau, and modern transformation workflows built with dbt.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the team
Our team plays a crucial role in ensuring the company’s success. We seek people who are willing to learn and put in the effort to solve problems. Our challenges are not your regular day-to-day problems - you’ll be part of a team that’s developing new solutions to new challenges. It’s working fast, at scale, and we’re making a difference. We are looking for talents to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Tech and Product PMO team based in San Jose. You'll drive the end-to-end tasks that keep the systems behind TikTok running and work with various team members to deliver best user experiences and highest-standard user privacy. As a TPM, you’ll be the bridge between various teams and drive collaboration tasks across teams.
- Work closely with global cross-functional teams from Product, Engineering, and Sales in the US and mandarin-speaking countries to drive the end-to-end delivery of new products, services, and/or features to market.
- Manage a variety of complex, cross-functional programs and lead all aspects of assigned programs delivery.
- Create and maintain the Roadmap for the teams by working with the respective Tech and Product leaders.
- Define the way of driving the programs and constantly find ways to improve the process in a data-driven manner.
- Prepare the project schedule, define the milestones, and be the owner of the collaboration process and tools.
- Track and report progress, identify and mitigate risks, and remove blockers.
- Ensure products and applications release to market smoothly.
- Mentor and help develop the team.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Must have a technical educational background, such as a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 3 years of relevant work experience in project/program management or software development leadership.
- Must have at least 1 year of experience in each of the following: Leading Agile development processes, managing software development projects, including building development processes and coordinating release schedules, or creating and maintaining software development roadmaps for engineering teams.
- Managing stakeholder relationships and gathering feedback to build programs that support customer revenue, growth, and retention.
- Planning and executing projects using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
- Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills.
- Experience operating in fast-paced environments and managing multiple priorities across time zones.
- Passion for problem-solving, process optimization, and delivering results in a data-driven and iterative way.
- Growth mindset with a willingness to take initiative and adapt in a constantly evolving environment.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for an experienced Aviation Energy & Utilities Program Manager in Newark, NJ.
This is a full time in-office position in our Newark, NJ office. You will be supporting the delivery of infrastructure projects related to aviation energy, including Central Utility Plants (CUP), Central Heating and Refrigeration Plants (CHRP), and Cogeneration (COGEN) facilities.

The successful candidate will lead multidisciplinary teams through planning, design, procurement, construction, and commissioning of aviation energy & utilities projects. This role will serve as a technical leader and/or owner’s representative and trusted advisor to airport clients, ensuring the successful execution of aviation energy & utilities projects in active airport environments, while maintaining regulatory requirements, safety/security standards, airport design & construction standards and operational constraints.

Your Impact

Lead and manage energy & utility infrastructure projects such as CUP/CHRP/COGEN from concept through commissioning.
Technical expert in the review/development of energy and utility systems, including turbines, electrical, controls
Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and technical approaches.
Ensure compliance with airport design standards, and applicable regulations along with quality and safety compliance.
Oversee design quality, constructability reviews, and risk management activities.
Coordinate with airport owners, airlines, regulatory agencies, and project stakeholders.
Manage project financial performance, resource utilization, and delivery metrics.
Support public sector procurement, outreach to industry, and breaking the program into deliverable projects.
Conduct project meetings and develop progress reports
Coordinate procurement, construction, testing, permitting and commissioning activities.
Manage project financials, forecasting, scope and schedule adherence and process related changes in conjunction with client approvals.
Collaborate with national aviation leadership to support strategic growth initiatives and major airport programs.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
10+ years of experience in airport energy and utility infrastructure projects, especially cogeneration.
Strong knowledge of PANYNJ design and construction standards or similar airport authorities, airport design criteria, and regulatory requirements.
Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams and complex aviation projects.
Experience in Program Management and/or as Owner’s Representative for major projects
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication abilities.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and competing priorities as part of Client’s work location at an airport.

Full time in office in the Newark, New Jersey area

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Capital One, models are the engines that drive our most salient business decisions. Capital One’s Model Risk Office (MROf) governs and maintains these engines to meet regulatory standards by defining the model risk management (MRM) framework and model governance practices for the company. At the cornerstone of our model governance framework are our Divisional Model Risk Officers (DMROs) and their teams.

As a Senior Associate, Project Manager at Capital One, you will support our well-managed divisions by ensuring our DMRO teams have insight into their operations, validation plans, and horizontal requests. Further, you will drive risk reduction efforts by managing a litany of important processes and controls. The role requires a well-rounded individual who is comfortable adjusting their approach to meet unique needs across multiple stakeholders within a complex organization. This role is ideal for someone with strong interpersonal skills, an unrelenting drive to ‘get things done’, and has a ‘can do’ attitude.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Meeting on a regular basis with stakeholders to ensure that they are well-managed and have line of sight into their operations, project plans, and horizontal requests
Utilizing a variety of business intelligence (Quicksite, Tableau), project management (JIRA), and analysis tools (Excel, Google Sheets) to support their stakeholders
Solving problems analytically - understanding how to join disparate data sets in an Excel or Google Sheets format to solve problems and convey a solution
Exhibiting a demonstrated track record of project management, bringing the ability to quickly put structure in place to manage tasks and related expectations
Exhibiting outstanding influencing skills to effectively drive project / program efforts - Demonstrate a proven track record of excellent project management, bringing the ability to quickly put structure in place to manage work in a dynamic complex environment.
Displaying a passion for coaching and developing delivery teams through leadership
Having excellent communication and partnership skills which are essential for interacting and communicating with key stakeholders at all levels across the company to manage, inform and influence outcomes
Having demonstrated experience in various project management / problem solving methodologies (waterfall, agile, design thinking, etc.)
Demonstrating the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Identifying continuous improvement opportunities using multiple data-driven approaches

The ideal candidate for this role can be described as someone who is:

Proactive
A self starter
Driven
Curious
Thrives in ambiguity and chaos
Fulfilled by directing and supporting others in task completion
A magnificent multi-tasker

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
At least 3 years of Project Management experience
At least 2 years of experience supporting, partnering and interacting with internal business clients
At least 3 years of experience using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, with a proficiency in joining disparate data sets to analyze and solve challenges

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree or Master of Business Administration (MBA) Degree
5+ years of Project Management experience
2+ years of model risk management experience in a regulated financial institution
2+ years of experience working with and applying the standards set forth in supervisory letters guiding model risk management, to include OCC Bulletin 2011-12 and FRB SR 11-7
2+ years of experience using JIRA or Github for Project Management
1+ year(s) of JIRA Project Administrator experience
Project Management Professional certification (PMP)
Lean, Agile, Six Sigma certification, or other Project Management Certification

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

McLean, VA: $96,500 - $110,100 for Sr. Project Manager

Richmond, VA: $87,700 - $100,100 for Sr. Project Manager

Riverwoods, IL: $87,700 - $100,100 for Sr. Project Manager

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
